name: reckless-conversion-banishes-four-random-memory-cards-reproducibly
notes: Reckless Conversion: draw two into memory, banish four at random from memory, [Class Bonus] return the rest to hand. The random picks used PHP's rand(), so replaying the same action from the same state banished different cards (the snapshot never matched twice).

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Many generated bodies choose 'at random' with PHP's native rand() / array_rand() / shuffle() (Reckless Conversion, random discards from memory/hand, Gaia's Songbird/Silvie-style 'random order' bottoms, ...). Unlike EngineRandomInt() that is not reproducible: undo-and-redo or a replay of the same action from the same state gave a different outcome, and fixtures with such effects were flaky. Fix: the shared action runner calls an optional game hook GameSeedNativeRandom() before every action; Grand Archive seeds mt_srand() from the same game-state hash EngineRandomInt() uses.
